name: post-traumatic
description: Firefox add-on that restyles the Traumasoft schedule calendar for phones.

scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir src --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest && node build/userscript.mjs
scripts.sign:listed: web-ext sign --source-dir src --artifacts-dir dist --channel listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json
scripts.run:desktop: web-ext run --source-dir src --pref general.useragent.override='Mozilla/5.0 (Android 15; Mobile; rv:143.0) Gecko/143.0 Firefox/143.0'
scripts.gist: gh gist edit ded7365e07fe74e89676e93bc5901c66 -f traumasoft-mobile.user.js userscript/post-traumatic.user.js
